description:
List functions in an analysis, filtered by coverage state.

``state_filter`` is a comma-separated subset of
``untested,partial,covered``. Default skips fully-covered functions
— those are typically what an agent looking for "tests to write"
cares about.

Rows include React sub-units — an inline JSX handler
(``Component.<onSubmit>``, ``kind="handler"``) or a conditional render
branch (``Component.<branch#1>``, ``kind="render_branch"``) — because
"this component's error state never rendered" is usually the actionable
gap, not "this component is 80% covered". Filter on ``kind`` in
``("function", "component")`` when you want whole functions only.
name: list_untested_functions
